{{Quote|<nowiki />''Defender One'', evacuate.|[[Antares Draco]]|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 46">[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]]</ref>}}
'''''Defender One''''' was an [[Empire-in-exile|Imperial]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] that ferried [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] and his [[Imperial Knight]]s to the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] to formalise an alliance between themselves and the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. The shuttle subsequently evacuated them again following an [[Operation: Thunderstroke|assault]] on the meeting by the [[One Sith|Sith]] [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]]. Fel's [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] the [[Dauntless (Pellaeon-class)|''Dauntless'']] managed to hold off the [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce]] long enough for the shuttle to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The ''Dauntless'' was then destroyed by the enemy flagship ''[[War Hammer]]''.
